reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Keep Element 99 transaction-tax amount range and numeric/assumed-decimal representation separate from Element 74 PC Tax Amount and total-tax semantics.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Symbolic Segment 100 field values only; complete transaction, currency, and tax-applicability context require authorized review.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References source-derived Segment 100 Test rules without changing the official Test baseline.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must confirm tax applicability, field encoding, currency/assumed decimals, and expected outcomes before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Tax Amount (Segment 100 Element 99) is numeric with valid values 1-9999999.
Tax Amount follows the total tax amount rule

sourceEvidence.quote: Number: 99 Name: Tax Amount Character Type: N Maximum Length: 8 bytes
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 99 is numeric with a maximum length of eight bytes.

sourceEvidence.quote: Variable length of up to eight digits with two assumed decimal places
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 99 uses two assumed decimal places; these range vectors do not test tax calculations.

sourceEvidence.quote: A maximum length of 8 bytes is allowed for American Express cards only. A maximum length of 7 bytes is allowed for all other card types.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The representation width has an Amex exception, while the valid value ceiling below is seven digits.
The valid numeric range starts at 1 and ends at 9999999.

aiReviewReferences.assessment: The AI's 1-9999999 valid-value range matches the source. All six hash-verified candidate observations declare Element 99 omitted, so they do not demonstrate the range, numeric type, or assumed-decimal representation.

testScenarios.intent: In an authorized Segment 100 context where sales tax applies, exercise the minimum, maximum, and out-of-range boundaries for Tax Amount Element 99.

testCases.assertion: Element 99 value 1 is the inclusive documented lower bound.
Element 99 value 9999999 is the inclusive documented upper bound.
Element 99 value 0 is below the documented valid range.
Element 99 value 10000000 exceeds the documented valid range.

openQuestions: Confirm Segment 100 tax applicability and currency context for complete request fixtures; ATL105 notes sales tax applies to EBT Cash Benefits only and not EBT Food Stamps.
Confirm whether value 1 encodes the minimum minor-unit amount under the assumed two decimal places in the production serializer.
Keep Element 99 total tax semantics and Element 74 PC Tax Amount independent from the range oracle.
Review complete Segment 100 fixtures and expected outcomes with the authorized Test owner before promotion or execution.
